definition: A person or ship is made so small that it can enter a molecule or atom, which is found to be a world of its own.

name: Submarine
definition: A vessel that submerges and travels under water by ballast control and its own propulsion, with crew sealed inside and lights to see by.

name: Submarine escape apparatus
definition: A hatch, chamber, buoyant capsule or breathing apparatus that lets the crew of a sunken submarine escape to the surface.

name: Submarine air supply
definition: Onboard machinery that makes oxygen and fresh air or water so a submarine can stay sealed and submerged for long periods.

name: Intercontinental passenger rocket
definition: A rocket vehicle that carries passengers or mail between distant cities on Earth by a high arcing flight through the upper atmosphere or space.

name: Subscription or pay-per-view television
definition: A television service the viewer pays for by subscription or per program, charged through a meter or box.

name: Subsurface scanning
definition: An instrument or ray looks into the ground or rock to find minerals, buried structures or cavities and display them.

name: Hidden subterranean civilization
definition: An unknown people with their own society or advanced science lives in caves or cities deep underground or in hidden lands.
aliases: Hidden underground or remote humanoid races

name: Vast subterranean world

name: Commuting and sprawl from fast transport
definition: Cheap, fast transport lets people live far from their work, so that homes spread out and long daily commutes between cities become routine.

name: Subvocal communication
definition: Speaking silently with throat or tongue movements, picked up by sensors, so as to transmit speech without sound.

name: Subway
definition: An underground urban railway or tunnel transit system moving people beneath a city.

name: Animals succeeding humans
definition: Rats, dogs, cats, tigers or insects evolving into intelligent beings who take over after humans.

name: Sunken lost continent
definition: A vast land such as Atlantis or a Pacific continent that sank beneath the sea and left ruins or remnants.

name: Sunlight channeled underground
definition: Collecting sunlight with reflectors or light guides and conducting it into buildings, ships or caverns for light and heat.

name: High-density capacitor storage
definition: A capacitor using a very high dielectric constant material to store large quantities of electricity.

name: New super-powerful explosive
definition: A chemical explosive far more powerful or sensitive than those known at the time, in liquid or solid form.

name: Super-long-range gun
definition: A huge gun able to shell targets scores of miles or leagues away.

name: Scientific supercomputing
definition: Very fast computers used to solve large mathematical and scientific problems beyond human calculation.

name: Cryotron or superconducting computer
definition: A computer built from switching elements that work by superconductivity at liquid-helium temperatures.

name: Superconducting power conductor
definition: A cryogenically cooled conductor that carries electric power with no resistance loss.

name: Instant mental calculation
definition: A person who computes large or exact arithmetic results in the head instantly, through innate gift or mental or cybernetic enhancement.

name: Superhuman strength
definition: A drug, process, symbiote or breeding that gives a human super strength, speed or leaping power.

name: Child with superhuman intellect
definition: A baby or child born with intellect far beyond adults, through mutation or experiment.

name: Divine or magical weather control
definition: Gods, kings, sages, psychics or demons that bring, stop or conjure rain, storms and drought by will, sacrifice or virtue.

name: Supersonic passenger aircraft
definition: A passenger aircraft cruising faster than the speed of sound, such as Concorde.

name: Surgical disguise and doubles
definition: Surgery, grafts or hypno-surgery that reshape a person's face, body and fingerprints into another person's likeness for impersonation or escape.

name: Living dinosaurs
definition: Dinosaurs or similar giant extinct reptiles surviving alive, on an isolated plateau, island or underground, and sometimes herded or hunted.

name: Living mammoths and Ice Age megafauna
definition: Mammoths, woolly rhinoceroses, cave bears and similar large Ice Age mammals surviving alive in a hidden land.

name: Living plesiosaurs and ichthyosaurs
definition: Extinct marine reptiles such as plesiosaurs or ichthyosaurs surviving in a hidden lake, sea or ocean.

name: Living pterosaurs
definition: Flying reptiles of the pterodactyl type surviving in a remote region and sometimes tamed.

name: Long-term suspended animation
definition: A drug, gas, machine or trance that holds a living person in a death-like stasis for years to centuries without aging, and revives them later unharmed.

name: Synthetic diamond
definition: Manufacturing real-quality diamonds artificially so they are cheap or indistinguishable from natural stones.

name: Synthetic flesh and skin
definition: Artificial skin or flesh that replicates or surpasses living tissue, used for repair, disguise or robot bodies.

name: Synthetic food
definition: Food is manufactured chemically or industrially from non-agricultural inputs, giving artificial meat, drinks and staples.

name: Synthetic or exotic liquid fuel
definition: A new compact liquid, gas or additive fuel that is more powerful than gasoline or coal for engines and aircraft.
bundle_check: Synthetic fuel and generic high-power new fuels; could separate.

name: Synthetic gemstones other than diamond
definition: Manufacturing rubies, sapphires and other gems artificially in real-gem quality.

name: Synthetic hallucinogen
definition: A newly synthesized psychedelic chemical that produces hallucinations and altered perception in tiny doses.

name: Synthetic ivory
definition: A manufactured substance that replaces natural ivory.

name: Creating life from nonliving matter
definition: Synthesizing living protoplasm, cells or new life forms from chemicals and controlling living cells.

name: Synthetic cloth and fibers
definition: Cloth and fibers manufactured chemically from wood or other materials, replacing natural cotton, wool and other fibers.

name: Tablet or portable note device
definition: A flat handheld electronic pad on which a person writes, types or reads notes and documents.

name: Communication with animals
definition: Humans learn the language of apes or other animals and talk to or command them.

name: Self-destroying safe
definition: A safe, vault or briefcase that destroys its contents or harms intruders if tampered with or opened wrongly.

name: Tank
definition: An armored, gun-armed vehicle on tracks or wheels that fights on land.

name: Teaching machine and computer-assisted instruction
definition: A machine or computer that presents lessons, tests students and grades their answers automatically.

name: Riot-control gas
definition: Tear gas or similar gas used to disperse crowds and suppress riots without killing.

name: Telekinesis
definition: A person moves or alters physical objects directly by mental force without touching them or using any device.

name: Remote diagnosis and prescription
definition: Doctors diagnose, prescribe or treat patients at a distance by telephone, tube, or radio.

name: Spacecraft telemetry link
definition: A radio link that streams measurements from a spacecraft or remote instrument continuously to a ground station.

name: Teleoperated robot and telepresence
definition: A robot or manipulator operated remotely by a person who sees, and sometimes feels, through its sensors.

name: Control of animals by mind
definition: A person commands or rides the minds of animals by mental power or music so that they obey.

name: Telepathic communication
definition: Mind-to-mind transfer of thoughts between people or other beings without speech or devices, sometimes across great distances.

name: Telepathic domination of minds
definition: A telepath taking over, compelling or enslaving other people's minds and wills at a distance or by contact.

name: Mind merging and shared consciousness
definition: Two or more minds fused or linked so that they share all thoughts and perceptions as one mind.

name: Telepathic mind reading
definition: Perceiving what another person is thinking, feeling or remembering directly by mental power, with or without their consent.

name: Telephone network
definition: A system of wires and exchanges that connects any two subscribers' telephones for voice calls.

name: Teleportation
definition: A person or object vanishes from one place and reappears at another instantly, by machine or by will, with no passage through the space between.

name: Teleprinter
definition: A machine that receives messages over wire or radio and prints them on paper at the receiver.

name: Television broadcasting
definition: A service in which stations transmit moving pictures and sound, scheduled or live, to television sets in many homes and distant screens.

name: Terraforming
definition: Changing the air, climate or soil of another world so that humans can live there without protection.

name: Artificial hypothermia in medicine
definition: Cooling a patient's body to lower metabolism so that surgery or treatment can proceed or the patient survives a crisis.

name: Seasonal heat storage
definition: Storing summer or solar heat in reservoirs, rock or underground for use in winter.

name: Materialization from thought
definition: A mind creates solid objects, food or living beings out of nothing by thought or wish alone.

name: Thought-to-text and thought display
definition: A machine that writes down a person's thoughts as text, or shows their mental images or dreams on a screen.

name: Three-dimensional motion picture
definition: A recorded film or performance that is shown in lifelike three dimensions, in a theater or at home.

name: Three-dimensional photograph
definition: A still image of a person or scene that appears solid and lifelike in depth.

name: 3D printing
definition: A machine that builds solid objects automatically from a digital design by adding material layer by layer.

name: 3D scanning of objects
definition: A device that records the complete shape or structure of an object so that it can be reproduced.

name: Three-dimensional television
definition: A broadcast medium that delivers stereoscopic or solid-looking three-dimensional moving pictures to home or public screens.

name: Tidal power
definition: Generating electricity from tidal flow using barrages or turbines.

name: Habitable twilight belt of a locked planet
definition: A planet with one face always toward its sun, whose narrow twilight band between hot and frozen halves has a livable climate.

name: Sealed knowledge repository
definition: A sealed, durable vault or museum preserves books, artifacts and knowledge for ages.

name: Drug speeding perception
definition: A drug that accelerates a person's nervous system so the world appears to move almost still, or slows subjective time.

name: Time travel
definition: A machine or means by which a person or craft moves into the past or future.

name: Time travel for military use
definition: Using time travel or time fields to raid, hide bases, invade or fight across eras.

name: Time travel to the future
definition: A person or vessel moves forward in time faster than the normal rate, arriving in a later era.

name: Time travel to the past
definition: A person or vessel physically moves backward in time to an earlier era by machine, field or portal.

name: Torpedo
definition: A self-propelled underwater missile that steers to and explodes against ships.

name: Touchscreen and gesture interface
definition: Controlling a machine by touching a screen or panel, or by hand gestures and gloves read by sensors.

name: Tracked all-terrain vehicle
definition: A vehicle on caterpillar tracks, half-tracks or special wheels that crosses rough, soft or hostile ground.

name: Remote tracking of a person
definition: A person is tracked at a distance by chemical, brain-wave or other trace signature.

name: Tractor beam
definition: A force beam or field that pulls a distant craft toward another ship so that it can be held or towed.

name: Riding giant birds and flying creatures
definition: Using large birds, falcons, insects or other flying creatures as mounts or draught animals to carry people through the air.

name: Riding sea animals
definition: Using trained dolphins or other sea creatures as steeds or draught animals to carry people across or under the sea.

name: Trajectory planning and coasting flight
definition: Flight paths computed in advance so a craft burns briefly and then coasts along a transfer orbit or escape trajectory.

name: Transatlantic flight
definition: A crewed aircraft flying across the Atlantic Ocean between the Americas and Europe or Africa.

name: Transatlantic tunnel
definition: A tunnel or tube running under the Atlantic Ocean to carry trains or capsules between Europe and America.

name: Transcontinental railway
definition: A railway line crossing a whole continent or linking distant continental regions.

name: Transparent vehicle body
definition: A vehicle whose body, canopy or hull is made of clear material, so occupants see out all around.

name: Identification transponder
definition: A device that automatically answers with a vessel's identity so that patrols can tell friend from foe.

name: Truth-compelling interrogation device
definition: A device or ray that makes a person unable to lie or reveals secrets during questioning.

name: Truth serum
definition: A drug that makes a person speak freely and reveal secrets under questioning.

name: Cure for tuberculosis
definition: A drug, treatment or program that cures or eliminates tuberculosis.

name: Tunneling and excavating machine
definition: A powerful machine bores tunnels or shafts through rock or earth, or excavates hills and streets.

name: Gas-turbine car
definition: A car or truck driven by a gas turbine engine instead of a piston engine.

name: Ultra-strong alloy
definition: A new engineered metal or alloy far stronger and harder than steel, resistant to corrosion, heat or weapons.

name: Ultralight metal
definition: A metal or alloy far lighter than known metals, used for aircraft, buildings and buoys.

name: Unbreakable or flexible glass
definition: A tough, transparent glass or glass-like sheet that does not shatter, bends, or can be woven or sealed against hazards.

name: Uncrewed cargo spacecraft
definition: A spacecraft without crew that carries cargo to a station or planet, guided automatically.

name: Underground command bunker
definition: A deep fortified bunker, base or arsenal built to survive attack and direct a war.

name: Telegraph and telephone cable
definition: A long cable laid under the sea or across country that carries telegraph or telephone signals between distant points.

name: Underwater communication
definition: Sound, cable or radio systems that let divers, submarines and ships talk to each other and to the surface.

name: Universal fabricator
definition: A machine that makes almost any object or material on demand from raw inputs, instructions or a wish.

name: Universal vaccine or lifelong immunity
definition: A single vaccine, serum or treatment that gives lifelong immunity against all disease or all germs.

name: Automatic decipherment of unknown languages
definition: A machine that learns or decodes a previously unknown language, such as an alien or lost tongue, from samples.

name: Universe-destroying weapon
definition: A weapon able to annihilate all matter or all living things in the universe.

name: Limitless cheap energy
definition: A source of power so abundant and cheap that energy is effectively free, ending scarcity and much human labor.

name: Drone (unmanned aerial vehicle)
definition: An aircraft without a pilot on board that flies by remote control or by itself to scout, carry or attack.

name: Surviving vacuum without a suit
definition: A treated human or trained person surviving in vacuum or at the edge of space without protection.
bundle_check: Includes the breathing-pill idea; both let a person live without ordinary air.

name: Unseen massive bodies and dark matter
definition: Dark stars, planets or structures detected only by their gravity or by bending of light.

name: Strange atmospheric lights and storms
definition: Unusual electrical or optical phenomena, such as daytime aurora, columns of lightning, rainbows, electric storms or green flames.

name: Urban air pollution
definition: Smog and fumes from industry and vehicles fouling city air.

name: Manufacturing in space vacuum
definition: Using the hard vacuum of space to make products that cannot be made on Earth.

name: Evacuated tube train
definition: A train or capsule that runs through a long evacuated tube at very high speed, often supported magnetically, for transcontinental or transoceanic journeys.

name: Variable-buoyancy airship
definition: An airship or balloon that rises and sinks by changing its own buoyancy, with heated gas, internal air cells or pumps, rather than dropping ballast or venting gas.

name: Vehicle crash occupant protection
definition: Padding, airbags, belts and shock absorbers in a road or other vehicle that protect its occupants in a collision.

name: Vehicle radiotelephone
definition: A telephone or radio-telephone installed in a car, patrol vehicle or boat to call a central exchange or base.

name: Television in a vehicle
definition: A television receiver installed in a car or other vehicle to show broadcast pictures.

name: Automated vending and self-service
definition: Machines that sell goods or prepare food and drink automatically without a shop attendant.

name: Intelligent life on Venus
definition: Venus has intelligent natives or creatures living in its jungles or clouds.

name: Jungle Venus
definition: Venus imagined as a hot, humid, cloud-covered world of seas and jungles, with a habitable surface under its clouds.
bundle_check: Includes native Venusian animals as part of the jungle Venus scenario.

name: Human settlement on Venus
definition: Humans build colonies, towns or stations on or above Venus and live there.

name: Vertical farm
definition: Producing crops in stacked multi-storey indoor farms, often in cities.

name: Video intercom and door viewer
definition: A two-way or one-way screen-and-speaker link between nearby places, such as rooms, offices, ship compartments or a front door, that lets people see and talk to one another locally.

name: Video on demand
definition: A service that lets a viewer choose and play any recorded program or live feed from a catalogue at will.

name: Video telephone
definition: A telephone that sends a live picture of each caller along with the voice, so that people at a distance see each other as they talk.

name: Immersive virtual reality
definition: A machine that feeds a person's senses a computer-generated world convincing enough to feel real.

name: Surgery that ends need for glasses
definition: Surgery or selective breeding that corrects eyesight so spectacles become unnecessary.

name: Transfer or draining of life energy
definition: Moving life energy or vitality between living beings to revive, rejuvenate or drain them.

name: Voicemail and answering machine
definition: A telephone service or machine that takes, records and keeps messages for a person who is absent, often in automated form.

name: End of Earth's volcanic activity
definition: A claim that the Earth's volcanic activity is dying out as its interior cools.

name: Volcanic eruption forecasting
definition: Warning people in advance of a volcanic eruption from precursor signs or measurements.

name: Control of volcanic eruptions
definition: Redirecting, damping or extinguishing a volcanic eruption by engineering, such as flooding a crater or venting lava.

name: Voluntary control of body functions
definition: Training that lets a person consciously control involuntary functions such as pain, temperature, weight, pupils or metabolism.

name: VTOL aircraft
definition: An aircraft that takes off and lands vertically with rotors, fans or jets and then flies forward on wings like an airplane.

name: Walking machine
definition: A machine that walks on mechanical legs and carries riders or pulls loads, from steam horses and steam men to legged vehicles.

name: Wall-sized flat television screen
definition: A very large, thin, flat video screen that fills a wall of a room and shows broadcasts or communications at large scale.

name: Warp drive
definition: A drive that bends, folds or tunnels space itself around a ship so it covers interstellar distances faster than light.

name: Ocean wave power
definition: Generating electricity from the motion of ocean waves with wave motors or converters.

name: Wearable computer and personal digital assistant
definition: A small body-worn or pocket electronic device that stores notes, schedules and reminders and gives its owner information on demand.

name: Wearable wings
definition: Large artificial wings strapped to the body, with or without a motor, that allow a person to fly like a bird.

name: Weather control
definition: Humans or beings command the weather, such as rain, storms, fog or temperature, at will.

name: Weather control
definition: A machine, tower or network of stations that regulates the weather of a region, for example scheduling rain and sunshine or breaking up storms, by electrical, ray or atmospheric manipulation.

name: Weather weapon
definition: A weapon that uses storms, wind blasts or artificial atmospheric effects to destroy forces or cities.

name: Weightlessness in spaceflight
definition: People and objects float freely in the free fall of orbit or coasting flight, so they move by pushing off surfaces.

name: Drug that removes will or emotion
definition: A drug given to people to make them docile, obedient or emotionless, or to alter their aggression, courage or inhibitions.
bundle_check: Joins personal obedience drugs and mass pacification gases; same function (a chemical makes people docile or obedient).

name: Wind turbine electricity
definition: Wind-driven turbines or windmills that generate electricity for towns, cities and industry.

name: Humans with wings
definition: People bred or engineered to have functional wings and fly unaided.

name: Barbed-wire entanglement
definition: Fields of barbed or plain wire laid in front of defenses to stop and snag attacking troops.

name: Wired broadcast service
definition: A subscription service that pipes live music, sermons, lectures or news into homes over telephone or cable lines.

name: Wireless headset and earpiece
definition: A worn earphone or headset that receives radio sound or lets the wearer talk hands-free.

name: Wireless power transmission
definition: Sending usable electrical power across a distance without wires, by radio, microwave or beam, to receivers such as lights and vehicles.
bundle_check: Includes space-to-space power beaming; same mechanism as ground wireless power.

name: Wireless telegraphy
definition: Sending coded messages by radio waves, without connecting wires, between distant stations.

name: Fantasy and euphoria drug
definition: A drug gives intense hallucinatory gratification of the user's desires and can be lethal or addictive.

name: Worlds inside atoms
definition: Whole inhabited worlds exist at microscopic scale inside an atom or speck of matter, and a nested hierarchy of scales extends both ways.

name: Liquid bandage and wound sealant
definition: A gel, film, tape or plastic coating that instantly seals and protects wounds, cuts and incisions.

name: Salvage of wrecks and cargo
definition: Cranes, buoys, pumps and submersibles that raise wrecks and cargo from the sea floor.

name: Wrist communicator
definition: A communicator or radio-telephone worn on the wrist like a watch for calls, messages or video.

name: Zombies and undead
definition: Corpses animated or possessed to move and act as soulless or blood-drinking beings.
